title: Dungeons Alive – source-grounded mob and animation production catalog
id_notice: mcd:/mcd2: IDs are this document’s stable keys. They are not Minecraft registries and not extracted Dungeons IDs.

included: all six Dungeons I DLC entity lists
Dungeons II publicly documented release mobs and roles
separately labelled attack helpers and ambient objects
excluded: ordinary projectiles, items and block decorations
every cross-product of armor tier, enchantment, size, difficulty, and color
removed merchant forms such as Wandering Trader and Trader Llama
scope.completeness: Broad documented inventory, not a verified export of every game asset or entity registry. Boss/Ancient lists reconciled against source taxonomy; individual variants and Dungeons II updates may still be incomplete.

counting_rules: Count entries, not new implemented mobs. A role, pet recolor, hazard, ancient, or armor appearance can have its own row.
base_entry and variant_kind identify derivatives; runtime IDs only appear where this project implements a prototype or an explicitly labelled counterpart/particle.
A vanilla_equivalent is an available Minecraft 1.21.1 entity type, not a Dungeons behavior port.
Boss labels use playable encounter taxonomy, not internal blueprint flags. Treetop Whisperer included as a boss encounter; raid captains remain miniboss variants.
Monarch Echo is a summon; Storm Generator tiers are variants; Grand Illusioner is a story antagonist until independent boss gameplay is evidenced.

evidence_legend.primary_confirmed: Name/role supported by first-party material as well as any listed secondary source; does not certify all design metadata.
evidence_legend.secondary_catalogued: Name/category catalogued by a community wiki; reference/playtest verification required before a faithful production implementation.
evidence_legend.animations: Own required animation-state design. Not a transcript or extraction of commercial animation files.

status_legend.vanilla_counterpart: Matching base creature exists in vanilla; Dungeons-specific behavior/animation remains open.
status_legend.prototype: Own registered entity with shared family geometry and simplified attack implementation.
status_legend.custom_profession_prototype: Own Villager profession/trades/working pose; original merchant service not ported.
status_legend.ambient_particle_only: Own decorative particle exists; not an interactive mob.
